tp05.answer: Code works out every correct answer, the error each item can show and the grid of which items check which error, and a printed key that differs is flagged, never trusted. You confirm every item before the paper can be used. An item the system cannot score yet, such as a word problem, is listed as not supported: leave it out or enter it by hand. A dictated item needs the number that was said.

tp06.answer: An imported paper says Imported, awaiting review until a reviewer confirms it, and it is not printed by the system because it is already printed. Enter check uses the chosen paper's own key, worked out by code from its numbers, so an imported paper is entered like any other. Once the first sheet is entered the paper is frozen and cannot change: make a new version instead. Each paper shows whether cohorts have formed.

tp10.answer: Code chooses it; the AI only words it. After module 1 the teacher plays it or marks it heard, then answers Tried it, Partly or Not yet, with an optional note (a child's name is removed before it is saved). Then she can press Generate next module, and the coach can press it for her. Tried it gives the next module in the track. Partly gives the same approach again, as a smaller step with more practice.
